mapper.select: SELECT o.id AS order_id, u.email AS buyer_email, e.id AS event_id, e.name AS event_name, e.start_time AS event_start_time, v.name AS venue_name, v.address AS venue_address, v.city AS venue_city, v.timezone AS venue_timezone, o.total_amount, o.discount_amount, o.promo_code, o.currency, (c.event_id IS NOT NULL) AS event_cancelled, c.reason AS cancellation_reason FROM orders o JOIN users u ON u.id = o.user_id JOIN reservations r ON r.id = o.reservation_id JOIN events e ON e.id = r.event_id JOIN venues v ON v.id = e.venue_id LEFT JOIN event_cancellations c ON c.event_id = e.id WHERE o.id = #{orderId}

SELECT ticket.id AS ticket_id, venue_section.name AS section_name, seat.row_label, seat.seat_label FROM tickets ticket JOIN event_seats event_seat ON event_seat.id = ticket.event_seat_id JOIN seats seat ON seat.id = event_seat.seat_id JOIN venue_sections venue_section ON venue_section.id = seat.section_id WHERE ticket.order_id = #{orderId} ORDER BY venue_section.display_order, seat.row_label, seat.seat_number, seat.id
